    and depth-aware stochastic depth. Pre-act ordering provides clean
    gradient flow; dual-pool SE (avg+max) yields richer channel stats;
    learnable alpha controls per-block residual magnitude; stochastic
    depth with p_L=0.1 gives mild regularization that scales with depth."""
    expansion = 1
    _bc = 0
    def __init__(self, in_planes, planes, stride=1):
        super().__init__()
        self.bn1, self.bn2 = nn.BatchNorm2d(in_planes), nn.BatchNorm2d(planes)
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(in_planes, planes, 3, stride=stride, padding=1, bias=False)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(planes, planes, 3, padding=1, bias=False)

                f"TRAIN_METRICS: epoch={epoch+1} train_loss={train_loss:.4f} "
                f"train_acc={train_acc:.2f} test_loss={test_loss:.4f} "
                f"test_acc={test_acc:.2f} lr={optimizer.param_groups[0]['lr']:.6f}",
                flush=True,
            )

        if test_acc > best_acc:
            best_acc = test_acc

    print(f"TEST_METRICS: test_acc={best_acc:.2f}", flush=True)
